scenarios.theme: One tenant generates half the writes. Why did tenant-based sharding not balance the cluster?
scenarios.assumptions: A directory puts each tenant on one shard. One tenant now dominates writes while several shards are idle. Its operations mostly touch independent projects. What will you change?

scenarios.theme: Data counts match after copying, but writes are still arriving. When can routing switch?
